name: landing-02-exits
prompt: Show the next screen of this same landing page after scrolling down. Keep the identical thin top navigation bar (the S logo and "Smart-Clearance", the links, "Sign in" and the green "Book a demo" button) and the same visual system, fonts and miniature-diorama photography. Replace everything below the navigation; the hero, its headline and the giant carton must not appear. Below the navigation, on the pale sage-white ground: 1) A left-aligned section heading in the same heavy dark display type, "Five exits, one batch", with one line beneath it: "MF-2409-117: 1,360 packs of masala chips with 47 days left. The agents priced every exit; two of them took the batch." 2) A wide horizontal panorama strip across the full width with rounded corners: a continuous tilt-shift miniature diorama of an Indian town seen from the side, running left to right: a distributor's godown with its shutter open and a few cartons outside, a road with a tiny van, a row of kirana shops with hanging snack strips, a small parcel hub, a small staff canteen, and a food-bank van with tiny volunteers. A thin glowing green path runs along the road from the godown to the kiranas and the parcel hub. Above the places, small white label cards: over the kiranas "Kiranas · 588 packs · 31 shops"; over the parcel hub "ExpireSoon · 772 packs · ₹14.20"; over the canteen, in grey, "Staff sale · priced, not needed"; over the van, in grey, "Food bank · priced, not needed". 3) At the far right end of the strip, set apart, desaturated and grey, a tiny smoking rubbish dump with a small red label "The bin · −₹26,330 · not taken". 4) Under the strip, three white cards in a row with large green numerals in the heavy display type and a small caption under each: "₹21,152" "recovered", "₹25,722" "better than the bin", "0" "cartons destroyed". Miniature diorama photography for the strip; crisp flat interface for the navigation, text and cards; all text legible.
postprocess: WebP; the PNG original stays local in .impeccable/mocks/
use: SC-25 design board: Section 'Five exits, one batch': a miniature panorama from the godown to kiranas, a parcel hub, a staff canteen and a food-bank van, with a grey smoking rubbish dump set apart at the end; three cards below read ₹21,152 recovered, ₹25,722 better than the bin, 0 cartons destroyed.
